assessment: Static public-interface review plus existing host and browser evidence. No new firmware or browser execution and no physical device commands.

position.producer: firmware/src/seq/sequencer.c:672-674 and firmware/src/app/engine.c:1254-1259 publish the fired per-part step in eng_step. The stock UI names active pattern or song bar at ui.c:5548 and consumes actual drum and bass position at 5702,5762. sequencer.c:992-1014 exposes a separate quarter-note phase to the stock UI.
position.runtime: worklet.mjs:114 emits frame {framebuffer,playing,keys,dim,buttons,peak,time}; observer.mjs emits owner identity, envelope snapshots and native time. Neither the public WASM exports nor the worklet frame include the per-track position, pattern, song bar or quarter-note phase.
position.midi: sequencer.c:1139-1142 emits 24-PPQN MIDI clock while internally running with clock output enabled. engine.c:1692-1710 treats inbound F2 as SMK clip clock display phase. Neither packet supplies per-track step, part pattern and song cursor. Different track rates, directions and cues prevent inferring these from pulses.
position.handoff: Publish a versioned read-only snapshot from the native render owner using actual per-part pattern and fired step, playing/wait status and song position. Bind it to runtime identity and ordering. Test stop/start/continue, cue, independent lengths/rates/directions, external clock loss and stale sessions. Repin the qualified build before consuming it.

existing_control_surfaces.device_info: editor.c:876-886 replies with product identity and zero parameter capability counts. stock-host.json captured actual INFO response and deferred DNR2 HELLO with no response.
existing_control_surfaces.music: engine.c:1740-1829 maps performance Notes, pitch-bend, CC1 and CC64 with conditional live recording. docs/MANUAL.md:775-794 documents per-part assignable MIDI channels and optional note/clock output.
existing_control_surfaces.smc: docs/SMC_MIXER.md:130-140 and smc_mixer.c:393-416 specify the opt-in ch16 host User preset: contextual faders CC40–47 and relative CC16–23. Neither the target mapping nor its feedback carries generic per-parameter identity and revision.
existing_control_surfaces.project: editor.c:169-171,240-345 maintains a global project hold. Export/import pause audio/input. COMMIT validates and applies the complete staged project. SAVE persists separately. No per-controller lease or read-to-write compare-and-set; a blind ABORT may affect another client. Stock offline-sequencer/device-sync.js:56-57 rejects live reads and writes without issuing commands. Its documented revision-13 project adapter supports a constrained offline edit/export.
existing_control_surfaces.emulator: worklet.mjs:29 accepts native panel button bits; page.mjs binds press/release. Existing tests/product-remote/playing-browser.py:13-16 exercises the native PLAY bit. Scoped native Mix and Chicago read/set/undo providers are available through native-session.mjs.
existing_control_surfaces.write_safety: Keep discovery read-only; no implicit notes, program changes, SMC commands or ED_PROJECT transactions. Only use an explicitly selected surface for a user action. New generic editing needs owner-bound identity, source parameters and a firmware-side revision-checked mutation/acknowledgement.

remote_transport_action.result: No supported idempotent Play or Stop on the Remote-owned session.
remote_transport_action.session: Pinned native-session.mjs:64 returns the AudioWorkletNode, context, gain, identity, activate and close only. Product local-instrument.mjs:27 returns the node port and admission pin to native control consumers.
remote_transport_action.command: worklet.mjs:29 takes a complete 14-bit button mask. The standalone page owns its held inputs privately (page.mjs:5-16). A Remote press or release cannot merge with a separate input owner. The only feedback buttons field is web_buttons_lit at worklet.mjs:114; page.mjs:32 uses it as lamps.
remote_transport_action.semantics: A fresh numeric playing observation is asynchronous. Neither the message nor worklet accepts expected state, desired state, or a request identity for transport, and no successful button acknowledgement names an applied transport state. Current stock ui.c:4193-4224 also dispatches contextual PLAY behavior including HOME+PLAY redo. The Remote should preserve Draft transport, REC and read-only actual playing feedback.
remote_transport_action.handoff: Provide an owner-serialized idempotent desired-state operation with request/session identity, explicit failure for unavailable modes, no button-mask replacement or REC mutation, and genuine post-apply transport readback. Requalify the producer and consume using the product session lifecycle.
